name: neo-linoleum
author: neostryder
description:
An alternative tile engine, and a much easier way to build a tile set: a folder of individual PNGs named after what they draw, instead of one sheet plus a table of pixel coordinates.

Enabling it adds six rows to the Graphics screen - Angband's own tile sets, converted - so you can compare both engines on the same art. The game's own graphics are core content and are untouched if you turn this off.

It can also do what a fixed sheet cannot: one symbol drawing from a pool of variants, picked by map position so a seed still replays identically. Build your own pack with the converter in the main repository, or by hand - the format is plain text plus PNGs (docs/LINOLEUM.md).

Converting somebody's tile set modifies their art. The Shockbolt packs ship under permission granted to Neo Angband specifically, conditional on this project not profiting, so check a set's licence before sharing a pack you built from it.
